absences.statement: There are no statewide measures on Delaware’s November 3, 2026 General Election ballot. The complete official corpus contains 530 district ballots and no ballot question.

provenance.quote: The sample ballot shows how your ballot will look when voting in–person on the voting machine.

coverageNotes: The Department of Elections' full November 3 general-election list supplies every Qualified candidate in the covered federal, statewide and legislative contests. Its separate declared write-in list supplies six additional Qualified candidates. Withdrawn entries are excluded.

Scott Walker is listed as a Provisional declared write-in for Representative in Congress and is not included among Qualified candidates. The Department says submitted residency materials remain under review by the State Election Commissioner.

The Department of Elections’ complete November 3, 2026 sample-ballot index contains 530 election-district ballots. All 530 complete official screen descriptions were acquired and inspected: every printed contest is a candidate race and none contains a ballot question. Delaware Code title 15, section 5002(a)(1)(g) requires the voting system to permit a voter to vote on every ballot question the voter may vote upon. This complete statewide ballot corpus establishes that there are no statewide ballot measures.
